subject: System Design
title: HTTP: The Language of the Web
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on HTTP: The Language of the Web.

hook.text: Every time you click a link, your browser sends an HTTP request. The server replies with an HTTP response.

buildup.text: HTTP defines methods like GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE for requesting and modifying resources.

discovery.text: HTTP is stateless: each request is independent. The server doesn't remember previous requests.

twist.text: Cookies and tokens were invented to add state on top of a stateless protocol. A clever workaround.

climax.text: HTTP is the foundation of the web. Every API, website, and web app communicates through it.

punchline.text: HTTP: request and response — the web's conversation.

quiz.question: Why is HTTP called stateless?
options: Each request is independent — the server doesn't remember previous ones
